entities.summary: Glenn Kassabin Hagan is an American former basketball player. He attended Cardinal Mooney High School in Rochester, New York, and St. Bonaventure University. After graduating from St. Bonaventure in 1978, he was an all-star guard for the Rochester Zeniths of the Continental Basketball Association in the early 1980s. He won CBA championships with the Zeniths in 1979 and 1981. He was a two-time All-CBA First Team selection in 1980 and 1981.
